messages.subject: Re: No Color Graphs Available in Plot Builder
parts:
the simple templates were simplified some time ago. This simplification invloved the removal of some options. coloring a scatterplot (which is what i assume you are talking about) was one of these.

to create a colored scatterplot go to geom -> point. Add in your x and y variables, then toggle the colour option so that you can add your color variable.
